purpose: Turn visitor intent into a creative, interactive and portable city-guide experience without forcing a fixed taxonomy of themes or profiles.

visitor_can: state an interest, mood, question, constraint or curiosity in natural language
accept, ignore, combine or reformulate suggestions
ask for more or less depth at any point
follow a new direction without being locked to an earlier choice
system_should: use the current place, route, already available guides and validated source material as context
offer a small number of optional context-sensitive suggestions when useful
make clear what already exists versus what would need to be generated
preserve important curatorial or factual context even when the visitor chooses a narrow interest
allow the conversation to discover an unexpected but relevant direction

content_resolution.preference: Reuse already-qualified content when it answers the visitor's intent; generate new content only when useful and route it through the normal research, factual and production gates.
content_resolution.composition: The resolved experience may combine content from several guides or narrative threads when provenance and context remain clear.
content_resolution.no_lock_in: A selected suggestion does not become a permanent axis or user profile.

content_model.base_episode: One clear, complete episode per accepted stop remains the reliable default.
content_model.optional_extensions: Use existing episode.extras or compatible qualified content for visitor-pulled exploration.
content_model.dynamic_threads: Topics and narrative threads are discovered from the visitor's language and available context; they are not pre-enumerated as the product ontology.
content_model.bridges: The guide may suggest another locally or cross-city relevant thread, but the visitor can ignore it and continue freely.
content_model.duration: Depth and duration are negotiated from visitor intent and context; they are design and QA signals, not fixed categories.

navigation_model.step_navigation: Keep per-step external maps deep links.
navigation_model.overview_navigation: A visit may expose one overview_maps_url for the full accepted route.

human_gate.required_when: A material artistic or product decision cannot be safely inferred from the visitor interaction, existing qualified content and reversible defaults.
human_gate.shape: Bring back a small number of concrete consequences or prototypes, not a closed menu of permanent thematic axes.
